protocol.py: 17 biology problems (17 warnings).

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 72 wells: 3 × 5 ul in 20 ul
   line 81:  p20.aspirate(vol, well)
   reached through: run:165 > mix_well:81
   At line 81 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 64 more in slot 1 with
   3 strokes of 5 ul in a well holding 20 ul (this line did it 72 times). 3 strokes of 5 ul
   move 0.75 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the mixing
   work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where
   twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in
   a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 64 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (16 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 16,
   well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [b6efaf9b5f27]

2. WARNING CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: fwd 1 (tube A2 in slot 2)
   line 106:  p20.aspirate(amount, tuberack[fwd_well])
   reached through: run:134 > prepare_mix:106
   At line 106 the tip went into fwd 1 (tube A2 in slot 2) while it still carried sybr (tube
   A1 in slot 2) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of
   it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong
   there. The protocol drew from it again afterwards, but only into wells that were given
   that material on purpose anyway, so this run is not harmed. What is left in the stock is
   no longer clean for the next run.
   Affected: tube A2 in slot 2.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 106 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing

at line 121, drawn at line 71

   At line 71 liquid was drawn out of it again, and the well was never mixed in between. Two
   liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not at
   the concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: tube A5 in slot 2.
   Also reached 23 other wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 15 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 121: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide

findings.title: Mixing too weak to stir 72 wells: 3 × 5 ul in 20 ul
findings.explanation: At line 81 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 64 more in slot 1 with 3 strokes of 5 ul in a well holding 20 ul (this line did it 72 times). 3 strokes of 5 ul move 0.75 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (16 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 16, well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.

findings.title: A used tip went into a stock: fwd 1 (tube A2 in slot 2)
findings.explanation: At line 106 the tip went into fwd 1 (tube A2 in slot 2) while it still carried sybr (tube A1 in slot 2) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong there. The protocol drew from it again afterwards, but only into wells that were given that material on purpose anyway, so this run is not harmed. What is left in the stock is no longer clean for the next run.
findings.fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 106 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids afterwards with a fresh tip each.
